3: For the music director, according to Shushan Eduth. A miktam of David. To teach. When he fought Mesopotamia and Aram Zobah, and Joab returned and struck Edom in the Valley of Salt, twelve thousand persons. O God, you have rejected us. You have broken us. You have been angry. Restore us!
4: You have made the land quake. You have split it open. Heal its fissures, because it totters.
5: You have shown your people hard things; You have given us wine that staggers.
6: You have rallied those who fear you round a banner ⌞out of bowshot⌟, Selah
7: so that your beloved ones may be rescued. Save by your right hand and answer us.
8: God has spoken in his holiness, “I will rejoice; I will divide up Shechem, and portion out the valley of Succoth.
9: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine, and Ephraim is the ⌞helmet for⌟ my head; Judah is my scepter.
10: Moab is my washing pot; over Edom, I will cast my sandal. On account of me, O Philistia, raise a shout.”
11: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
12: Have not you yourself rejected us, O God, and not gone out with our armies, O God?
13: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of humankind is futile.
14: Through God we will do ⌞valiantly⌟, and it is he who will tread down our enemies.
